Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: This PPN applies to all central government departments, their executive agencies and non-departmental public bodies (collectively referred to as ‘in-scope organisations’). Other public sector contracting authorities may wish to apply this approach set out in this PPN.
heading_path: Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: As the Government increases its use of Artificial Intelligence (’AI’), it is essential to take steps to identify and manage associated risks and opportunities, as part of the Government’s commercial activities. There is a range of guidance available to support commercial teams to understand AI as a subject area, the appropriate use of AI within public services and how AI products should be procured; found in Annex A of the PPN. The PPN also provides some optional questions that can be incorporated into tenders (for information only) to understand suppliers’ use of AI, and to support risk management and mitigation of AI services in the delivery of the service.
heading_path: Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: It is important to note that suppliers’ use of AI is not prohibited during the commercial process but steps should be taken to understand the risks associated with the use of AI tools in this context, as would have been the case if a bid writer has been used by the bidder.
heading_path: Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: In certain procurements where there are national security concerns in relation to use of AI by suppliers, there may be additional considerations and risk mitigations that are required.
heading_path: Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Where AI is likely to be used in the delivery of a service, commercial teams may wish to consider requiring suppliers to declare this and to provide further details (see example disclosure question, i.e question 3, in the PPN).
heading_path: Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Overview
Improving transparency of AI use in procurement
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: In-scope organisations should be aware of the risks associated with the use of AI. To mitigate these risks, additional clarifications or supporting documentation might be required to ensure the accuracy and robustness of the tender.
